author: Doppelganger_
body:
Name: Doppelganger_
Banned for: Click Aimbot
Why should I be unbanned from the server?: I should be unbanned from the server because my ban really is false. Also I have yet to see the evidence against me for me to explain the ban. I also achieve 9-10 cps https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NDx8jRu9cyM and for the aimbot part have played almost 350hrs of call of duty black ops 2 before playing minecraft and have played approximately 14 days on here and oc.tc collectively not including the countless hours i have played on other pvp servers.

title: Doppelganger_'s Appeal

replies.author: chaibrit1
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to appeal your ban due to the lack of evidence by the Moderator to support this claim. However, if you are banned for hacking once again with sufficient evidence, your chances of being appealed will be very low. Sorry for the inconvenience. 

Regards,

GalaxyBrit
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
